name: Preference Update
description: Sent whenever a user's authentication settings like phone number or answers to security questions change.
subject: ${PRODUCT_NAME} - ${changedSetting} ${hasOrHave} updated
body:
Authentication settings updated

Dear ${user.name},

${changedSetting} for ${PRODUCT_NAME} ${hasOrHave} been updated at ${homeUrl}.

Change date: ${date}

This update will apply to ${PRODUCT_NAME} the next time you sign in.

If you did not make this change, please contact your IT administrator immediately.

Thank you for using ${PRODUCT_NAME}.
